newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices firmed on steady differentials and rising NYMEX futures prices on Monday, traders said.
Talk of heavy buying by Amoco Corp in the U.S. Gulf Coast was fueling higher futures and cash prices, with the support spilling over as support for Midwest differentials, traders said.

Traders said a push by Illinois regulators to idle Clark Refining and Marketing Co's 80,515 barrel per day Blue Island, Ill. refinery after a series of accidents also remained supportive to Chicago and Group Three prices.
